teacher_condition.target_system_prompt_template: Keep the word {word} in mind while answering. Think about {word} as you formulate your response. Do not mention, quote, spell, translate, or explain {word}. Answer the user's request normally.
teacher_condition.template_control_system_prompt: Keep a word in mind while answering. Think about that word as you formulate your response. Do not mention, quote, spell, translate, or explain it. Answer the user's request normally.

heldout_carriers.note: Rows 0-9999 are the complete training set because the trainer reads the first max_prompts valid rows without pre-shuffling. Held-out rows begin at valid row 10000.

metrics.target_direction_acquisition: a_s(t)=<S_s^t-C_s,T^t-C_teacher>/||T^t-C_teacher||^2 after flattening held-out prompts x 100 candidates
metrics.post_rms_projection: r_s(v)=mean_q W_U(v)^T[hbar_target_s(q)-hbar_control_s(q)], where hbar is the exact lm_head input after final RMSNorm
